rationale: The Latin anchor *ædificare* ("to build/construct") directly maps to the sense of constructing or erecting a structure, which aligns precisely with raise.v.09 ("construct, build, or erect"). The sibling gloss and attestations (e.g., Ors. 3, 9) confirm a literal building/construction sense, ruling out the more general "cause to rise up" of rear.v.04.
